media_recommendations.rationale: Selected Cat6a (10GBASE-T) because link distance (45.0m) is within the 100m horizontal cabling limit (IEEE 802.3an). Enables PoE++ power delivery and cost-effective RJ-45 termination for edge switches.

Selected OM4 Multimode Fiber (10GBASE-SR) because link distance (220.0m) exceeds copper 100m limit but operates within the 400m modal dispersion limit of OM4 850nm VCSEL optics (IEEE 802.3ae). Provides cost-effective campus backbone interconnections.

Selected OS2 Single-Mode Fiber (10GBASE-ER) because link distance (19.50 km) exceeds the 10 km reach of 10GBASE-LR. Utilizes 1550nm cooled EML laser operating in the minimum silica attenuation window (0.25 dB/km) with an optical power budget supporting up to 40 km metro MAN interconnects without mid-span amplification.

! ===========================================================================
! CISCO IOS CONFIGURATION: CORE / DISTRIBUTION MULTILAYER SWITCH
! Scenario: Custom Dual-Zone Enterprise Datacenter
! Hostname: CUSTOM-DATACENTER-CORE-SW01
! Generated automatically by NetArchitect Recommendation Engine
! ===========================================================================
enable
configure terminal
hostname CUSTOM-DATACENTER-CORE-SW01
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption
ip routing

! --- VTP DOMAIN HARDENING ---
vtp mode transparent

! --- 802.1Q VLAN DATABASE DEFINITIONS ---
vlan 100
 name Kubernetes_Container_Workloads
 exit
vlan 110
 name Database_High_Availability_Clust
 exit
vlan 120
 name Public_Ingress_DMZ_Reverse_Proxi
 exit
vlan 130
 name Out_Of_Band_Management_IPMI
 exit
vlan 999
 name QUARANTINE_NATIVE_VLAN
 state suspend
 exit

! --- SPANNING TREE PROTOCOL (IEEE 802.1w RAPID PVST+) ---
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree vlan 100,110,120,130 priority 4096
spanning-tree portfast default
spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default

! --- HARDENED 802.1Q TRUNK UPLINKS (DTP DISABLED) ---
interface range GigabitEthernet0/1 - 2
 description UPLINK-TO-ACCESS-SWITCHES
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport nonegotiate
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 100,110,120,130
 spanning-tree guard root
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- SWITCHED VIRTUAL INTERFACES (SVIs) & GATEWAYS ---
interface Vlan100
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Kubernetes_Container_Workloads
 ip address 192.168.0.1 255.255.248.0
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan110
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Database_High_Availability_Cluster
 ip address 192.168.8.1 255.255.254.0
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan120
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Public_Ingress_DMZ_Reverse_Proxies
 ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan130
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Out_Of_Band_Management_IPMI
 ip address 192.168.10.129 255.255.255.192
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- DYNAMIC ROUTING CONFIGURATION ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 192.168.0.1
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface Vlan100
 no passive-interface Vlan110
 no passive-interface Vlan120
 no passive-interface Vlan130
 network 192.168.0.0 0.0.7.255 area 0
 network 192.168.8.0 0.0.1.255 area 0
 network 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 192.168.10.128 0.0.0.63 area 0
 exit

end
write memory

! ===========================================================================
! CISCO IOS CONFIGURATION: ACCESS LAYER SWITCH
! Scenario: Custom Dual-Zone Enterprise Datacenter
! Hostname: CUSTOM-DATACENTER-ACCESS-SW01
! Generated automatically by NetArchitect Recommendation Engine
! ===========================================================================
enable
configure terminal
hostname CUSTOM-DATACENTER-ACCESS-SW01
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption

! --- VTP TRANSPARENT MODE ---
vtp mode transparent

! --- VLAN DEFINITIONS ---
vlan 100
 name Kubernetes_Container_Workloads
 exit
vlan 110
 name Database_High_Availability_Clust
 exit
vlan 120
 name Public_Ingress_DMZ_Reverse_Proxi
 exit
vlan 130
 name Out_Of_Band_Management_IPMI
 exit
vlan 999
 name QUARANTINE_NATIVE_VLAN
 state suspend
 exit

! --- RAPID SPANNING TREE ---
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst

! --- HARDENED TRUNK TO CORE SWITCH ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description UPLINK-TO-CORE-DISTRIBUTION-SWITCH
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport nonegotiate
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 100,110,120,130
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- ACCESS EDGE PORTS (WITH PORTFAST & BPDU GUARD) ---
interface range FastEthernet0/1 - 24
 description ACCESS-ENDPOINTS-VLAN-100
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 100
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
 no shutdown
 exit

end
write memory

! ===========================================================================
! CISCO IOS CONFIGURATION: ENTERPRISE BORDER / CORE ROUTER
! Scenario: Custom Dual-Zone Enterprise Datacenter
! Hostname: CUSTOM-DATACENTER-BORDER-ROUTER01
! Generated automatically by NetArchitect Recommendation Engine
! ===========================================================================
enable
configure terminal
hostname CUSTOM-DATACENTER-BORDER-ROUTER01
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption

! --- INTERFACE CONFIGURATION ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description LAN-INTERNAL-CORE-LINK
 ip address 192.168.0.254 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 description WAN-PUBLIC-UPLINK
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- HARDENED ROUTING ENGINE PROTOCOL ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 192.168.0.1
 log-adjacency-changes
 network 192.168.0.0 0.0.7.255 area 0
 network 192.168.8.0 0.0.1.255 area 0
 network 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 192.168.10.128 0.0.0.63 area 0
 exit

! --- ENTERPRISE DEFENSE ACCESS CONTROL LISTS (ACLs) ---
ip access-list extended ACL-ISOLATE-IOT-AND-GUEST
 remark Permit established return sessions
 permit tcp any any established
 remark Permit internal DNS and DHCP
 permit udp any any eq domain
 permit udp any any eq bootps
 permit udp any any eq bootpc
 remark Deny guest and IoT access to internal corporate subnets (RFC 1918)
 deny ip 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 172.16.0.0 0.15.255.255 172.16.199.0 0.0.0.255
 permit ip any any
 exit

end
write memory

executive_rationales: Physical Media Strategy: Deployed Cat6a 10GBASE-T for horizontal runs <=100m (IEEE 802.3an), OM4 MMF 10GBASE-SR for intra-campus backbone runs <=400m (850nm dispersion limit), OS2 SMF 10GBASE-LR/ER for long-span inter-building and MAN runs (zero modal dispersion). All link selections strictly adhere to IEEE 802.3 attenuation and transceiver optical budgets.

Layer 2 Resiliency: Enforced IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (Rapid PVST+). Provides sub-second failure recovery (<1s) via edge port fast transitions and direct proposal-agreement handshakes, eliminating legacy 802.1D 30-50s listening/learning delays.

Subnetting & Addressing: Implemented descending bitwise VLSM allocation within 192.168.0.0/20. Allocated 4 non-overlapping subnets (2752 total addresses reserved, 1920 active hosts) achieving 69.8% address space efficiency. All wildcard masks derived via bitwise unsigned negation.

Routing Architecture: OSPF Area 0 (Single Backbone Area). Selected OSPF Area 0 because network scale (4 subnets, single Autonomous System) is well within the 50-subnet threshold for a single area. Eliminates ABR route summarization complexity while guaranteeing instant topological convergence via Dijkstra's Shortest Path First algorithm. (Reference: IETF RFC 2328 (OSPFv2)).
